title: RecordPagedQueryResponse
description: Paginated response containing a list of change history records.

count.description: Number of records in this page.

results.description: The change history records on this page.

Change.description: A single field-level change within a change history record.

change.description: The name of the update action that caused this change (e.g., 'setCustomField', 'changeOrderState').

type.description: The type identifier of this change entry.

previousValue.description: The field value before the change was applied.

nextValue.description: The field value after the change was applied.

ModifiedBy.description: Information about the actor who made the change.

id.description: System-generated ID of the user or client.

type.description: The type of actor that made the change.

clientId.description: ID of the API client used to make the change.

anonymousId.description: Anonymous session ID if the change was made without a customer login.

isPlatformClient.description: Whether the change was made via the Merchant Center.

Record.description: A change history record capturing a set of changes applied to a resource in a single operation, along with actor and timestamp metadata.

id.description: System-generated unique identifier for the record.

resourceVersion.description: The version of the resource after these changes were applied.

resourceType.description: The type of resource that was changed.

changes.description: List of individual field-level changes captured in this record.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the changes were made.

label.description: A label identifying the changed resource (e.g., product name, order number).

previousVersion.description: The version of the resource before these changes were applied.

Reference.description: A reference to another resource by typeId and id.

typeId.description: The type identifier of the referenced resource.

id.description: The system-generated unique identifier of the referenced resource.
